title: vivo Buds Ultra launch in Europe with 60dB ANC and dual drivers
description: Back in June, vivo unveiled the TWS 5 Pro buds in China alongside the X Fold6. Now, what looks like the very same pair of earbuds is making its way to Europe under a new name - vivo Buds Ultra. They use a hybrid driver setup, with an ultra-compact balanced armature co-developed with Knowles sitting in the center of the diaphragm of a dual-fold dynamic driver developed by vivo. The company says this coaxial design aligns the acoustic centers of the bass and treble for a balanced sound, while a dedicated acoustic tube physically isolates high and low frequencies. There's a 16Hz-60kHz...

title: vivo X500 Ultra said to use a larger telephoto sensor over its predecessor
description: Back in July, well-known tipster Digital Chat Station claimed that vivo was deciding between three 200MP sensors for the telephoto camera on its upcoming camera flagship, the X500 Ultra. Now, the tipster suggests that the company may have made its choice. According to a recent post by the tipster, the latest engineering sample of the vivo X500 Ultra is testing a 200MP 1/1.2-inch sensor for the telephoto camera. vivo appears to have found a way to accommodate the larger sensor without taking up too much internal space. For comparison, the vivo X300 Ultra features a 200MP telephoto...

title: Lisbon through the lenses of the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max
description: We have an interesting early look at the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max before our review goes live. We were given the chance to take the phone around the streets of Lisbon and take some photos to share with you! It's still pre-announcement, so we can't talk specs and we won't talk quality, but here go some samples. Feel free to share your opinions, though! title: Omdia: foldable displays shipments will increase 44% this year with a focus on wide foldables
description: Foldables are growing in popularity – market research firm Omdia forecasts that foldable display shipments will rise by an impressive 44% this year, after a 12% decline last year. Note that the forecast is specifically for the inner displays of foldables and not the foldables themselves – there may be some delay between the time the display component is shipped and when the final product is shipped. According to the forecast, 29 million foldable displays will be shipped this year. As noted above, this might not translate 1:1 into the number of foldable phones shipped, but it’s clear...

title: Lava Aura Curve unveiled with curved display, rear screen, and 6,000mAh battery
description: Lava recently unveiled the Virat Curve in India, featuring a curved display and a secondary screen on the back. The company has now introduced the Aura Curve, which offers the same design and specifications but is aimed at the offline market. The Lava Aura Curve will be available through offline retailers across India, priced at INR 23,999 for the 6GB/128GB variant. The Aura Curve comes with the MediaTek Dimensity 7100 SoC, a 6.67-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, a secondary rear AMOLED display, and a 6,000mAh battery with 45W fast charging support. It...

title: Redmi K100 to get a 50MP rear camera, ultrasonic fingerprint scanner
description: Redmi has revealed more details about the K100 ahead of its launch in China on October 26. The phone will join the Redmi K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max, which were unveiled in August. The Redmi K100 will feature a dual-rear camera setup, headlined by a 50MP Light and Shadow Hunter 800 main sensor with a 1/1.55-inch sensor size and an f/1.68 aperture. The phone is also confirmed to offer an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance, along with an ultrasonic in-display fingerprint scanner. In another Weibo post, Redmi revealed that the K100 will feature symmetrical dual speakers, seven...

title: Coolpad unveils the Cool X Wide with a 16:10 display and 50MP camera
description: Chinese smartphone maker Coolpad isn’t a brand we cover often, but the company has just launched the Cool X Wide, a widescreen smartphone similar to the Huawei Pura X View. Naturally, we had to take a closer look. The Coolpad Cool X Wide features a 6.38-inch LCD display with an HD resolution, a 90Hz refresh rate, and a wide 16:10 aspect ratio. It is powered by the MediaTek Helio G99 chipset, which is paired with up to 12GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 256GB of UFS 2.2 storage. The phone has a 50MP main rear camera and a macro sensor, however, Coolpad hasn’t revealed details about the...

title: Oppo Reno17 Pro specs leak, and they sound very familiar
description: Oppo's Reno17 series is rumored to launch in China next month, and today prolific tipster Digital Chat Station has revealed the key specs of the Reno17 Pro. If you've been following the brand's releases closely, they will sound very familiar. According to the leak, the Reno17 Pro will have a 6.32-inch flat display with 1.5K resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate, and it will be powered by MediaTek's Dimensity 8550 Super chipset. That's exactly the screen size and chipset of the global Oppo Reno16 Pro, which isn't to be confused with the Reno16 Pro for China, a bigger 6.78-inch phone with the...

title: Apple now sells iPhone 18 Pro repair parts
description: After expanding its partnerships with American suppliers for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, Apple has also started selling repair parts and tools for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max through its Self Service Repair Store, along with parts for the M5 Max and M5 Ultra Mac Studio and the M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini models. title: Apple expands partnerships with American suppliers for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro
description: Today Apple has announced new and expanded partnerships under its American Manufacturing Program (AMP), for critical materials and components used in the iPhone Duo and the iPhone 18 Pro, since nearly 100 components in those phones, from wireless chips to the silicon that powers key functions, are produced by American companies, with suppliers spread across more than a dozen states. title: Apple caps iPhone Duo purchases at two per person in an attempt to tackle scalpers
description: Apple opened the iPhone Duo pre-orders about four days ago and seconds after the shipping dates slipped into January next year. With every product in extremely high demand and low on stock, scalpers gather and try to buy the item in large quantities and then sell it at an inflated price. That's why Apple now imposes a limit of two iPhone Duos per customer. The limit has so far been confirmed in the US, UK, Japan and Spain, but it's likely worldwide. There are already some eBay listings selling the iPhone Duo at an eye-watering $5,000. This is not the first time Apple is trying...

title: UK wants Apple to open up iPhone contactless tech and charge lower fees
description: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has outlined proposals that would force Apple to open up the NFC tech in the iPhone to more third parties, on more favorable terms. According to the regulator, "Apple's fees and rules are blocking UK fintechs and other businesses from innovating and growing." The CMA says it has heard from UK businesses that Apple's current NFC access arrangements may not be commercially viable, that its fees and other terms may be onerous, and that the different technical approaches across countries and platforms make it harder to scale and compete. The...

title: Samsung improves the power efficiency of the Exynos modems for the Galaxy S27 phones
description: Samsung’s Exynos-powered phones haven’t had the best reputation when it comes to standby power consumption – their modems tend to use more battery than the modems inside Snapdragon-powered Galaxy phones. But Samsung LSI may have finally cracked the problem. The M2700 modem, which will be used alongside the Exynos 2700 chipset in some Galaxy S27 models, promises better power efficiency, according to insiders who spoke to The Elec. “I understand that the M2700 achieved performance equivalent to or better than competitors' products through voltage adjustment and other measures,” said one...

title: Verizon's Straight Talk upgrades its unlimited plans without raising prices
description: Straight Talk, which is owned by Verizon, has announced upgrades for its Silver Unlimited, Gold Unlimited, and Platinum Unlimited plans, adding faster 5G Ultra Wideband access, more hotspot data, expanded international coverage, and Home Internet bundle savings. The monthly base prices stay the same, and the Silver Unlimited plan has been $45 per month since 2009, impressively. That plan now gets 5G Ultra Wideband access, 15GB of hotspot data (50% more than before), and unlimited international talk and text to Canada, Mexico, India, and China. Gold Unlimited, at $55 per month, also...

title: The iPhone Duo may not have a visible crease, but the display is soft in that area
description: The part of the iPhone Duo display that is above the hinge is squishy – this can be seen in a video originally posted by Weibo user Kang that was shared by Ice Universe. This is not entirely unexpected, but it’s still interesting to see. The perfectionists over at Apple couldn’t have a crease on their first-ever foldable. And to their credit, they engineered a solution – the crease is essentially invisible. This doesn’t mean that the strip over the hinge has solid backing, though. So, if you push it with your finger, it depresses slightly. Worse, Kang says that when pressing the screen...

title: Samsung Galaxy A36's One UI 9 update lands in Europe
description: Samsung started rolling out the update to Android 17 with One UI 9 on top to the Galaxy A36 last week, but it's only been available in South Korea. That has now thankfully changed, as the update is also rolling out in Europe. [#InlinePriceWidget,13497,1#] It arrives over-the-air as a 2.38GB download, so make sure you grab it over a fast enough network. After you install it, your Galaxy A36 will be on software version A366BXXUCDZIF, and the September 5, 2026 security patch level. title: Doogee previews the Note60 W: a widescreen slab inspired by the Huawei Pura X View
description: Doogee previewed an interesting phone at the 140th Canton Fair – a widescreen slab phone that seems heavily inspired by the Huawei Pura X View. The Doogee Note60 W has a 6.38” display that seems to have the same 5:3 aspect ratio as the Pura X View. That one has a 6.39” display and while that sounds small, it measures 144.1mm tall and 87.0mm wide. For reference, the iPhone 18 Pro Max is 163.4mm tall and only 78.0mm wide. Doogee Note60 W The Doogee phone will have a 90Hz display and will come with Android 17 out of the box. It will pack a 6,500mAh battery inside an 8.4mm body,...

title: Samsung signs huge DRAM and HBM contracts
description: Samsung has reportedly signed a massive five-year long-term memory chip deal that will see the majority of its general-purpose DRAM and HBM memory chips go to “global big tech companies”. A new report from Yonhap News suggests that 70% of Samsung’s DRAM supply and a full 100% of the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips that are set to be produced next year are already reserved. The report also specifies “fierce competition” for the remaining 30% of Samsung’s DRAM orders. title: Shipping dates for the iPhone Duo have been pulled forward for many users
description: Apple got slammed with pre-orders for the iPhone Duo – the demand outstripped supply so badly that shipping dates around the world were quickly pushed back to January 22. But maybe the wait won’t be so bad as multiple users are reporting that their shipping dates have been pulled forward. If you have pre-ordered the iPhone Duo, have a look at the estimated shipping date – you may be in for a pleasant surprise. Ray Wong of Gizmodo says that many X users from Japan are seeing the initial November/December shipping estimates be pulled forward all the way to October 23 – that’s the official...

title: Oppo's wide-screen phone tipped to pack an 8,000mAh battery
description: Several details about Oppo’s rumored wide-screen smartphone have leaked over the past few weeks, with the latest one suggesting that it will feature a triple-rear camera setup with two 200MP sensors. A new leak has now revealed the phone’s battery capacity. Tipster Digital Chat Station has shared the full specifications of the Oppo wide-screen phone, which is rumored to be called the Reno X.
